4b0efeff91850860.job_title: Sales Executive – Commercial Kitchen Equipment (Foodservice & Direct Accounts)

In this role, your primary focus will be engaging directly with end-user business operators, including restaurants, hotels, cafes, and catering companies, to understand their culinary setup needs and facilitate direct sales. Strong experience in the hospitality equipment sector is essential for success in this position. Key Responsibilities • Direct Foodservice & Venue Sales (Primary Focus): Drive direct sales of commercial kitchen equipment, refrigeration, stainless steel fabrication, and dishwashing systems to restaurant owners, hotel F&B managers, cafe operators, and commercial caterers. • Field Prospecting & Pipeline Building: Identify new venue openings and active fit-outs through cold calls, site visits, and relationships with local chefs, restaurant managers, and hospitality entrepreneurs. • Site Consulting & Proposals: Review kitchen space layouts, interpret technical requirements (including 60Hz KSA electrical standards), and prepare professional Bills of Quantities (BOQs) and commercial proposals directly for business owners. • Corporate & MEP Alignment (Plus): Collaborate with MEP contractors, engineering consultants, and corporate project managers on larger developments that require institutional bidding. • Closing & Sales Targets: Lead price negotiations and contract signing to consistently achieve monthly and annual revenue goals. Key Requirements & Qualifications • Experience: 3-5 years of proven sales experience in commercial kitchen or hospitality equipment in Saudi Arabia (Riyadh market experience preferred), with a strong track record of selling directly to restaurant and hotel operators. • Technical Proficiency: Solid understanding of commercial kitchen gear, layout blueprints, and utility connections (electrical & plumbing integration). • Mandatory Qualifications: • Status: Valid, Transferable Iqama (currently residing in KSA for immediate hire). • Licensing: Valid Saudi Driver’s License. • Languages: Fluent English is required. Business Arabic is a strong advantage for direct client relations; knowledge of Urdu/Hindi is beneficial for site and back-of-house coordination. • Education: High School Diploma / College Diploma or equivalent (Technical/Engineering background is a plus). What We Offer • Competitive base salary with an attractive performance-driven commission structure. • Company support for business transportation/allowance. • Dynamic work environment with clear career advancement opportunities. Skills • Experience: 3-5 years of proven sales experience in commercial kitchen or hospitality equipment in Saudi Arabia (Riyadh market experience preferred), with a strong track record of selling directly to restaurant and hotel operators. • Technical Proficiency: Solid understanding of commercial kitchen gear, layout blueprints, and utility connections (electrical & plumbing integration).

4bcedd5ec96f4e04.job_title: Senior Full Stack Programmer - IT | Saudi Arabia Senior Full stack Programmer - IT | Saudi Arabia
4bcedd5ec96f4e04.description: Join a leading Saudi technology and systems integration company specializing in delivering innovative enterprise IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud, networking, and digital transformation solutions to government, enterprise, and commercial customers across the Kingdom. The Senior Full Stack Programmer will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, maintaining, and supporting enterprise web applications across front-end and back-end environments. The role requires a highly experienced software professional capable of developing scalable applications, troubleshooting complex technical issues, integrating enterprise systems, supporting production environments, and providing technical guidance in a fast-paced technology solutions environment. Key Accountabilities: Design, develop, implement, and maintain high-performance enterprise web applications across front-end and back-end environments. Develop modern and responsive front-end applications using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, AngularJS, latest Angular, and WebAssembly . Develop and maintain back-end applications, services, and APIs using C# and .NET Core 9+ . Utilize Entity Framework, ORM technologies, and appropriate Design Patterns to develop scalable, maintainable, and high-quality applications. Design, develop, optimize, and maintain databases using SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB . Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and application services to support enterprise systems and business requirements. Implement application security, authentication, authorization, data protection, and secure coding practices . Deploy, manage, and support applications using Docker and Kubernetes . Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate application build, testing, deployment, and release processes. Monitor application performance, identify potential issues, and resolve complex application, integration, database, performance, and production incidents . Plan and execute application upgrades, migrations, configuration changes, and deployments while minimizing operational disruption. Coordinate with project managers, business stakeholders, infrastructure, cybersecurity, database, and application teams to ensure effective application delivery and issue resolution. Support application testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and production operations , ensuring timely resolution of technical issues. Maintain accurate application architecture documentation, source code, configurations, API documentation, deployment procedures, and operating guidelines . Ensure applications can be developed, deployed, and maintained effectively within air-gapped, isolated, or restricted environments . Provide technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and support to junior developers and technical team members to enhance team capabilities and development standards. Knowledge, Skills, and Experience: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology , or a related field. Minimum 5–7 years of experience in full-stack software development, preferably within a large-scale technology, enterprise, government, or systems integration environment. Strong hands-on experience with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, AngularJS, latest Angular, and WebAssembly . Solid experience with C#, .NET Core 9+, Entity Framework, ORM frameworks, and software Design Patterns . Strong experience with SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQL, and database management . Hands-on experience with Telerik, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines . Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, application integration, authentication, authorization, application security, and performance optimization . Strong understanding of software architecture, development best practices, scalability, maintainability, and application performance . Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex application, integration, database, performance, and production issues . Experience with application deployment, upgrades, migrations, configuration changes, and production support . Experience working within air-gapped, isolated, or restricted environments . Strong experience coordinating with cross-functional technical teams, project stakeholders, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and database teams . Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills , with the ability to work effectively under pressure. Experience providing technical guidance and mentoring to junior developers and team members is an advantage.

4b18b76d5293faf0.description: Job description Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 25 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money. The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 70,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores. Tabby generates over $18 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region. Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and is now valued at $6,5 billion. About the role Tabby is known for BNPL, but credit is our fastest-growing business. Saudi Arabia is our biggest market, and we want to build a full consumer lending line there. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager based in Saudi Arabia to build that business from the ground up and own its P&L. This is not a feature role. You will define what the product is, how it is priced, who qualifies, how it stays compliant. What you will be doing The product construct. Define the lending products we launch in KSA and across Tabby's other markets, including eligibility, tenors, limits, repayment structure, and what happens at every edge of the flow. The P&L. Revenue and cost are yours: profit rates and pricing etc. You build the business case, commit to the numbers, and explain every month why they moved. Work with legal, compliance and external partners, and so the customer experience does not suffer for it. Billing and servicing logic. Billing logic, repayment options, early settlement, late fees, collections hand-offs. This is detailed work: you will sit with engineering and specify, case by case, what lands where and why. Strategy. Where this business should be in 12 and 24 months, which segments we serve, what we build next, and what we deliberately do not build. What you will need Saudi Arabia residency, familiarity with the market and an understanding of local culture 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager. Experience with credit or lending products matters most, but strong experience in fin-tech or tech products also works A proven track record of managing complex product lifecycles and delivering successful products Attention to detail, our products work with people's money, so precision matters at every step Comfort working with risk, compliance and legal to get a product approved, not just designed Resilience and the ability to adapt in a rapidly changing environment Fluency in English and Arabic Benefits What you can expect Ownership & Impact: A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one. Culture: Collaborative, inclusive, and driven environment where your voice matters. Flexibility: Enjoy flexible working hours designed to optimize productivity and balance. Growth: Participate in the company’s employee stock options program and shape your career trajectory. Support: Comprehensive health insurance, generous PTO and a Flexible Benefits budget to meet your personal needs. We are passionate about creating an inclusive, high-performing workplace that gives people from all backgrounds the support they need to thrive, grow, and meet their goals (whatever they may be). If this sounds exciting to you, we’d love to hear from you! Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

4bc670a64fb25615.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ترينجل ديزاين عن مهندس إنشائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يركز هذا الدور على تخطيط وتصميم ومراجعة الخطط الإنشائية التي تتطلب تحليلاً دقيقاً للإجهادات، بالإضافة إلى إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال الهندسية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية حساب حجم وشكل ومقاومة ونوع العناصر الإنشائية، أو إجراء تحليل إنشائي للعناصر مسبقة التصميم. تصميم العناصر الإنشائية بناءً على الأحمال المقدرة. تفقد الإنشاءات القائمة وتقديم التوصيات لإصلاح أو استبدال العناصر الإنشائية المعيبة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الإنشائية. القدرة على تخطيط وتصميم ومراجعة الخطط الإنشائية بكفاءة. مهارات قوية في تحليل الإجهادات وإعداد التقارير الفنية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في تبوك، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل المهندس الإنشائي ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة ترينجل ديزاين، مساهماً في مشاريع الشركة المتنوعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الإنشائيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عملنا في تبوك للتقديم على هذا الدور.

The Senior HRSD Solution Architect will collaborate with HR leadership, process owners, Business Analysts, Enterprise Architects, Technical Leads, Developers, and external partners to transform business requirements into sustainable technology solutions. The role is accountable for establishing the target HRSD architecture, defining solution patterns, evaluating technology options, and designing integrations. Key Responsibilities Own the end-to-end technical architecture for HRSD initiatives and major enhancements. Define current-state, target-state, and transition architecture for HR service delivery. Ensure alignment between HR business strategy, HR processes, enterprise architecture, and technology solutions. Lead architecture decisions for ServiceNow HRSD and related HR technology platforms. Define integration strategies between HRSD, HRIS, payroll, identity management, enterprise applications, and third-party systems. Establish technical standards, reusable architecture patterns, and governance principles. Ensure solutions are secure, scalable, highly available, upgradeable, and aligned with enterprise technology standards. Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to project and delivery teams. Review and approve solution designs, integrations, configurations, and technical implementations. Identify opportunities for automation, self-service, AI, and digital transformation within HR service delivery. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyad Al Khabra, Al Qassim, Saudi Arabia. The role involves close collaboration with various internal teams and external partners throughout the solution lifecycle, from initial discovery and requirements through design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
